title: The Little Things
summary: Sometimes happiness is hiding in the smallest parts of an ordinary day.
body:
There are days when nothing especially big happens—and somehow those are the days worth remembering. A warm cup of coffee. A quiet morning. A song that makes you smile. A little moment that reminds you that life can be soft, too.

I think we spend so much time waiting for the big things that we forget to notice the tiny ones already happening around us. So today, I’m choosing to notice them.

title: A Slow Morning
summary: Permission to take the morning gently, one sip at a time.
body:
Not every morning needs a plan. Sometimes the best thing you can do is sit down, breathe, and let the day arrive at its own pace.

Today I’m letting my coffee be enough of a reason to pause. There will be plenty of time for everything else.
